reuse_authorization: Explicit user request 2026-10-16; reuse reviewed data, code and outputs

prior_plan.source_annotation: Released celltype; confirmed identical to final_annotations with mature/immature colonocytes and goblets merged as source Figure 4 code lines 333-337.
prior_plan.assay_reference: No_Cytomix; not a newly screened candidate
prior_plan.matching: Same donor, pool and published celltype; pool retained only if treatment and combined cytomix-only controls each contain >=20 released cells. Sum counts across eligible matched pools and technical control wells within donor before inference.
prior_plan.unit: donor; require >=3 matched donors per condition-celltype, no cell or pool pseudoreplication
prior_plan.gene_prefilter: Condition-blind total raw count across paired pseudobulks >=10; no effect or P-value filter.
prior_plan.DE: DESeq2 1.44.0 design ~ donor + treatment; no LFC shrinkage, no automatic outlier replacement; independentFiltering=FALSE; retain Cook outlier flags and exclude nonfinite/P-unavailable ranks.
prior_plan.enrichment: Unshrunken Wald statistic; fgseaSimple, 10000 permutations, minSize=10, maxSize=500, scoreType=std, nproc=1, seed=20260826. All finite ranks, no significance prefilter.
prior_plan.multiple_testing: BH: all 16 TNFSF12 celltype-module tests as primary; all 96 other original-nominee tests as secondary; 16 No_Cytomix assay-reference tests separately. Planned missing estimates remain NA and retain family denominator.
prior_plan.donor_scores: Mean within-donor/condition gene rank using all released genes; positive raw-rank change in disease-depleted module is favourable. Exact two-sided sign-flip P from paired donor changes, with same predeclared multiplicity families. This has low power with three donors.
prior_plan.scope: Targeted reanalysis of original nominations, not a new candidate screen or independent perturbation replication. Preserve complete original estimates. No original threshold, set or candidate rank is overwritten.
prior_plan.limitations: Three healthy organoid donors, source injury model, no clinical safety or functional-rescue endpoint. GSEA tests gene-set enrichment and does not add donor replicates.

FDR.main: All released ligand x four family x three primary readouts; BH with full planned n, including NE
FDR.assay_reference: Separate No_Cytomix four-readout x family family, same as targeted

classification: Strict unrounded donor deltas; require 3 observed pairs; both if all three same donor records have up<0 and depleted>0. Otherwise up-only, depleted-only, other observed directions. Zero counts in neither sign.
benchmark: Within family across ligand mean paired raw-rank deltas, Pearson and Spearman descriptive coefficients without independence-based P; donor-stratified coefficients also reported. NoCytomix excluded.
example_selection: Before analysis: within each family and joint-pattern category choose lexicographically first ligand, plus lexicographically first ligand for each disease/IFN donor-direction discordance category. Never rank by efficacy or significance.
new_score_tests: None. No permutation/sign-flip analysis is a completion requirement.
old_models: Reuse all saved targeted estimates/scores/coverage/gene results unchanged
old_FDR: Keep separate immutable columns and archived tables
IBD_policy: Use only saved reproducible members plus required directions/weights; publisher aggregate scores are a separate source and not same-rule comparisons
